# What’s new in OverCue Desktop 2.0.0

- Prepare Vocals, Drums, and Instrumentals from your rekordbox USB playlists with the built-in stem engine.
- Select multiple tracks, sort by playlist position, and use one Export stems or Re-export stems action. Delete stems from the same toolbar.
- Follow each track’s export progress and reuse compatible prepared stems from another connected USB.
- See a welcome guide on first launch and release notes the first time you open an updated app.
- Get dismissible notices when app or firmware updates are available. Update the app in Settings and prepare player updates in Firmware.
- Read what the latest firmware changes and fixes directly in the Firmware page.
